preview: Guyana Amazon Warriors face St Kitts & Nevis Patriots in CPL 2026 Match 28 at Providence Stadium. The match is scheduled for Sun 6 Sep at 10am local time.
preview_detail: Guyana retain Shimron Hetmyer, Romario Shepherd, Shai Hope and Shamar Joseph, while 10 of their 12 locally selected players come from Guyana. The Patriots unite CPL's leading career run-scorer Johnson Charles with Andre Fletcher, while Jason Holder returns to strengthen an experienced Caribbean group. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
